scope: This PDF only. Earlier years are retrospective reports in a 2010 geography, not contemporary historical notifications.
reviewer: Codex visual inspection of source pages

evidence.finding: The heading names Scheduled Caste allocations. Page 2 printed serials 24-27 have SCL in the 2010 column and serials 28-34 have SC.
The allocation heading names the backward class. Compound-code gender semantics are inferred from the document's code system, not a literal printed legend.
The heading names allocations reserved for women. Page 10 printed serial 19, Sheetalpur GP 11, has L in the 2010 column.
The headings identify unreserved allocations. Page 13 printed serial 1 and page 118 printed serial 2 have UR in the 2010 column.

limitations: A literal legend spelling out SC/SCL and BC/BCL was not located. Their gender interpretations remain explicit research inferences.
Applying the same alphabet to 1995, 2000, and 2005 uses the source's common table code system; it does not validate historical identities or source accuracy.
Blank and zero codes are unknown, never unreserved. Conflicting source assignments receive no normalized candidate.
No observation becomes a validated central-dataset assignment through code normalization alone.
